packed=base64.b64decode(encoded,validate=True)
assert len(packed)==11036 and hashlib.sha256(packed).hexdigest()=='79ece82f06d3a254294a1b754587254d799eacf9e3bf191adb8f1e74ae324581'

files=json.loads(data);assert len(files)==12
root=Path(sys.argv[2]);root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
for name,content in files.items():
 p=Path(name);assert not p.is_absolute() and '..' not in p.parts
 out=root/p;out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);out.write_bytes(content.encode())
for name,info in json.loads(files['MANIFEST.json']).items():
 b=(root/name).read_bytes();assert len(b)==info['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==info['sha256'],name
print('COORD_CONE44_FULLBAR92_SOURCE_RECOVERED')
